provenance.title: Bookstore catalog upsert store
provenance.trimmed: kept the Beanie models, the Mongo connector (upsert logic) and the BookSchema; dropped the scraper, scheduler, logger, configs. Port drops OpenAI embeddings and keeps a subset of book fields
provenance.mapping: Author/Book Documents -> nodes; Book.author_id ObjectId -> edge Author -[Wrote]-> Book; MongoDBConnector.on_parse (_save_author find-or-create by name, _save_book upsert by url) -> walker save_book; read helpers -> walkers
provenance.hidden_tests: no upstream tests; hidden tests exercise on_parse semantics (author reuse, url upsert/refresh, author change re-link, complect/no-author skip) with uuid tags
provenance.reference: hand-written idiomatic Jac port (claude), validated by convert_build
